fusions.name: Royal Decree
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of edict into the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage. If it lands, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Heralded Arrival
fusions.desc: Hits every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 11 damage to each and stunning it for 0.8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Long Arm of Law
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
